basis: 50 posts: @itsbgra 11 (7 videos, 4 photo posts); references 39 (@offtherackjack 8, @wearecrossfader 8, @dj.r2e 7, @dj__mandy 8, @theonlydjdrip 8 — the last mostly 2021–22). Pictures looked at: both first-frame grids, palettes, hook strips of the top post of 3 accounts and your 'Day 1' overview.
summary: Your best content already exists: transition recipe cards (track A → B, technique, bars, BPM, key) earned your top two posts (633 and 208 likes vs a median of 11 for your videos), and nobody in the niche shows recipes like that. Your videos lose because of how they are shot and mastered, not what they show: landscape footage letterboxed into black (luma 33 vs 97), audio at −31 LUFS vs −17, no face and no voice, while every winning reference opens on a person filling the 9:16 frame with a one-line hook on top. Keep the recipes and the journey framing, film vertical, talk to beginners, master loud, and own a warm lamp-lit look in a niche of blue LED rooms.

traits.label: You (or you holding the gear) on screen at frame 0
traits.evidence: Seen: about 30 of the 37 reference first frames show a person; 0 of your 11 do (hands only in 3).

traits.label: Transition recipe cards: A → B, technique, bars, BPM, key
traits.evidence: Measured: your 2 most-liked posts are Mixnote combo cards (633 / 13.5K views and 208 / 4.7K) vs median 11 likes / 365 views for your videos. Seen: no reference shows recipe data like this.

traits.label: Numbered journey series ("Day N of learning to DJ")
traits.evidence: Measured: @wearecrossfader's Day 1 (95K likes, 1.3M views) and Day 2 (20.1K, 217K) are that account's top 2. You already posted Day 1 and Day 3, letterboxed (11 and 13 likes).

traits.label: Name the blend in the hook: "Song A → Song B"
traits.evidence: Seen: @offtherackjack "Ayo × California Love", "Seven Nation Army × Losing It"; @theonlydjdrip "2 songs that needed to be mashed together". You already write "Nightcrawlers → Daft Punk".

traits.label: Full-frame 9:16 footage, no black bars
traits.evidence: Measured: your videos' luma 32.9 vs 97 for references; seen: your deck footage sits letterboxed in the middle ~40% of the frame (Day 1 overview), every reference fills the frame.

traits.label: Master to about −14 LUFS
traits.evidence: Measured: your videos −30.9 LUFS median (−26 to −42) vs references −16.8; your photo posts on official TikTok sounds sit at −7 to −9.

traits.label: Cut in by ~4 s, then let the blend play in long takes
traits.evidence: Measured: references' top half by likes cut first at 3.7 s vs 5.0 s and hold longer shots, 23.7 s vs 16.5 s (n=37). Your videos are one static 23–50 s take.

traits.label: Keep videos around 45–60 s
traits.evidence: Measured: references' top half run 55 s vs 67 s for the rest; median 59 s. Yours run 23–50 s.

traits.label: One- or two-line text hook at the top
traits.evidence: Seen: most reference first frames and 9 of your 11 posts carry a 1–2 line label near the top ("DAY 1 OF LEARNING TO DJ", "been practicing this run all week").

traits.label: Word-by-word captions whenever you talk
traits.evidence: Seen: @wearecrossfader's top post captions every spoken word. Measured: educators speak ~1.9 words/s vs 0.28 in yours (music only).

traits.label: Show the waveforms, playlist or screen
traits.evidence: Seen: @offtherackjack's most-liked post (19.1K) is a colour-coded rekordbox playlist; waveform strips in his tutorial template; @dj.r2e waveform close-ups.

traits.label: Warm amber "lamp-lit session" palette
traits.evidence: Measured: your vivid accents are amber #AE7845 / #D49F6D (desk lamp) and navy #14365D; references' are blue/violet LED #2532DA, #373E82, #6387C8. Nobody in the set owns warm.

traits.label: Open by naming the viewer: "If you're a beginner DJ…"
traits.evidence: Measured from transcripts: 6 of @offtherackjack's top 8 open with "If you're a beginner DJ…" or "I'm going to show you…"; @wearecrossfader's top 2 open "Day one of you learning to DJ".

traits.label: Learning in public: honest wins, fails and notes
traits.evidence: Seen: your captions already do it ("I keep notes on how I did each", "How did you find this one out?"); @dj__mandy's self-aware tone tops the set (245K likes).

traits.label: Answer comments as videos (reply sticker on screen)
traits.evidence: Seen: @wearecrossfader Day 3 and Day 4, @theonlydjdrip song requests, @offtherackjack "someone just asking me".

traits.label: Tag for beginners: #beginnerdj #howtodj #learningtodj
traits.evidence: Measured: references' top hashtags include #beginnerdj #howtodj #learningtodj; yours are #djmix #housemusic #djtransition, which reach DJs who already mix, not the beginners you want.

traits.label: Use the official track sound on photo posts
traits.evidence: Measured: all 4 of your photo posts use the official track (Pjanoo, FISHER "It's That Time", Groovejet, Modjo) at −7 to −9 LUFS; your 7 videos use quiet "original sound".

traits.label: Blue/violet LED backdrop
traits.evidence: Seen: @wearecrossfader's blue wall and @theonlydjdrip's purple neon; it is the niche default and part of their look.

keep: Transition recipe cards (technique, bars, BPM, key) — your best format
Naming blends "A → B" in the hook
House and disco classics taste (Purple Disco Machine, Daft Punk, Eric Prydz, Modjo)
fix: No face, no voice → you at frame 0, talking to beginners
One static take → a fast hook, then the blend
protect: The recipe card itself: nobody else in the niche shows the data
Learning-in-public framing ("Day 1", "been practicing this run all week")

whitespace: No reference shows the transition recipe as data (technique, bars, BPM, key, Camelot step); your Mixnote cards do, and they are your top posts.
Everyone teaches as an expert or performs as a personality; nobody is a real learner showing receipts — what they tried, what they saved, what worked.
The niche lives in blue/violet LED rooms; a warm amber lamp-lit look is open.
Every reference uses TikTok's default white text box; a branded label would be recognisable in the feed.

signatures.what: Purple title box plus white "DJ Mix Tutorial" pill, face on top, controller below, waveform strip between
"DAY N OF LEARNING TO DJ" white label on a blue LED wall, holding the controller up to camera
signatures.note: inspiration only, do not copy (the numbered series idea is generic grammar)

signatures.what: Deadpan, self-aware persona and big-stage cutaways
Chicago juke / function identity, coloured mix-name labels

palette.notes: Yours: near-black, warm browns and lamp amber with a navy accent. References: neutral skin/wood tones with blue/violet LED accents. Mixnote cards add a dark UI with a violet-blue gradient.

sound.notes: House tempo (≈122–131 BPM). References speak over music in teaching posts; showcase posts are music only. 35 of 37 reference videos use original sound.

openQuestions: Is Mixnote your app? If so, the brand can make "save it in Mixnote" its call to action and the recipe card its signature.
Will you talk on camera, or only voice-over and text?
Can you film vertically (phone above the decks plus a front camera), or is landscape footage all you have?
